sources.text:
Lake Kermajärvi is a peaceful paddling destination in the middle of our beautiful national landscape. You can admire the magnificent archipelago landscape scattered across open waters by following the well-known Heinävesi route and its numerous canals. The passage through Heinävesi from Savonlinna to Kuopio is considered one of Finland’s most beautiful waterways. Kermajärvi is a nationally valuable landscape area and nature reserve.

A peaceful paddling and boating destination for independent visitors.
There are three excursion harbours in the nature reserve. Nearby services for boaters.
Good fishing destination.
The Heinävesi water route, which is known as the most beautiful of its kind in Finland, crosses Lake Kermajärvi.
Nature
Kermajärvi is a nationally significant landscape and nature conservation area, valuable for the protection of the unbuilt inland water shores, archipelago, and open water nature, as well as forests.

stops.name: kermajärvi
stops.detail: Der Kermajärvi-See ist ein friedliches Paddelziel inmitten unserer wunderschönen Nationallandschaft. Sie können die herrliche Archipellandschaft bewundern, die über offene Gewässer verstreut ist, indem Sie der bekannten Heinävesi-Route und ihren zahlreichen Kanälen folgen. Die Passage durch Heinävesi von Savonlinna nach Kuopio gilt als eine der schönsten Wasserstraßen Finnlands. Kermajärvi ist ein national wertvolles Landschafts- und Naturschutzgebiet.
